headline: Neumann rides stingy defense to the conference summit
dek: Neumann conceded only fifteen goals while scoring 36 across a fourteen-win season that also included two draws and four defeats. That defensive control carried the program through conference play unbeaten, matching Messiah at the top of the table despite a far smaller attacking output.
displaced_by: Messiah's published win total revised from nineteen to seventeen; Neumann's defense now anchors the lede.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Messiah operated in a separate scoring class, scoring 63 goals while conceding 24—more offense than Stevenson and Albright produced together, with the rest of the conference clustered in a narrow band.

wire.line: Messiah won seventeen matches, drew two, and lost three, yet still finished level with Neumann atop the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches in the conference schedule sit past their dates with no published result, and both belong to Albright: August trips to Chestnut Hill and Dickinson.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Messiah sophomore Owen Resch produced fourteen goals and eleven assists from 95 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eastern (Pa.) goalkeeper Michael Arcuri stopped 78 shots while conceding twenty goals for a 0.796 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stevenson spread its offense across at least sixteen different goal scorers while posting 41 goals for and twenty against.

last_match.line: Messiah closed the season with the conference's highest goal total and its most wins.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
